[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Bragan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] soldier who served in the [[Republic Army|Republic army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] where he battled against the Separatist forces. However, he and his men were pinned down by the separatists that were able to take control over [[Mannett Point]]. With the Separatists in control of the Point, the weapons had been turned against the Republic soldiers in the area. He later tasked a Republic spacer to take those weapons out of the separatists' hands.

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Bragan appears as a mission-giver in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on Ord Mantell. According to the game's text files, Bragan was originally named Brannigan.
